main_text.head: Annulus pretiosa gemma ornatus.
XIX.
main_text.p: [woodcut: emblem of a ring set with a gem, enclosing a small plant, in a landscape with rocks, trees and clouds]

p.i: Qvalis qua fuluo circumdata cernitur auro Gemma nitens, radio splendidiore micat :
Talis formoso splendens in corpore virtus, Nescio quod prodit conspicienda decus.

page.notes: The woodcut is an emblem picture (ring with gem and plant in landscape) and is described, not transcribed. The catchword "Canis" at the lower right is printed in the page's catchword position. Several letters in the verse are set in a long-s style that is transcribed as plain s; "decus" is printed with a final period.
